earnings.name: Earnings
earnings.structural_pattern: earnings base x earnings multiple x bounded growth adjustment
earnings.design_principle: Earnings-based models require sector-aware growth caps and bounded multiplicative structures to avoid systematic overprediction.

cashflow.name: Cash Flow
cashflow.design_principle: Cash flow models require sector-aware adjustments, growth scaling, and explicit handling of negative cash flow to avoid systematic underestimation.

asset.name: Asset
asset.structural_pattern: book value x price-to-book x R&D-intensity adjustment
asset.design_principle: Asset-based models require bounded multiplicative structures, sector-specific adjustments, and controlled use of high-impact variables to avoid instability and invalid predictions.

growth.name: Growth
growth.structural_pattern: base x growth factor or market-relative multiple
growth.design_principle: Growth-based models require sector-specific adjustments, growth elasticity, and bounded scaling to avoid instability and extreme prediction errors.

quality.name: Quality
quality.structural_pattern: earnings base x cash-flow multiple x ROE adjustment
quality.design_principle: Quality-based models require growth-aware scaling, bounded transformations, and sector-specific adjustments to balance stability and predictive performance.

reproduction_target.tier_1_structural: recover the five equation families per perspective per market
reproduction_target.tier_2_directional: MUFASA lower MAPE than all 17 baselines in all 5 markets
reproduction_target.tier_3_quantitative: reproduce Table 2 MAPE values within stochastic tolerance and Table 5 DM verdicts
reproduction_target.unreproducible_headline_claim_policy: The paper's reported 19.65% average improvement is not exactly reconstructable from Table 2 or Table 5 under either pooled-vs-PySR (20.00%) or mean-per-market-vs-PySR (19.47%). The reproduction must declare its own aggregation basis, report its own computed value, and explicitly state that the paper's value is not verifiable from its published tables.

global_constants.aggregation_doctrine_note: The paper's Table 2 differences are not reconcilable with its Table 5 DM differentials under any constant rescaling, indicating two different aggregation orders were likely used under the same metric name. The reproduction must compute both and diagnose which matches the reported numbers.

variable_codebook_schema.naming_mismatch_warning: Released learnings use machine names (SECTOR_MEDIAN_PE, BS_CUR_LIAB) while released equations use symbols (NI_ps, PE). Explicit mapping is mandatory.

ROE vs RETURN_COM_EQY — total equity vs common equity

sigma_EV_EBIT — cross-sectional dispersion vs time-series dispersion

reconstruction_definitions.NEGATIVE_CASH_FLOW_FACTOR: 0 if cf_free_cash_flow_ttm >= 0; 1 if 0 > FCF >= -1e3; 2 if FCF < -1e3

reconstruction_definitions.Prediction_Coverage: Fraction of firm-quarters with finite prediction

context_registry.regime_causality_note: Peak/trough dating in this family is normally confirmatory. An ex-post construction would leak future information into the weight matrix. The causal (running-extremum) construction is the primary; the ex-post variant is run only as a robustness specification.

differential_evolution.feature_standardisation_rule: Standardise regressors to zero-mean unit-variance using training statistics before the DE fit; unscale fitted coefficients afterward. This produces comparable coefficient magnitudes across markets and reduces DE ill-conditioning without altering the structural form.

semantic_retrieval_procedure.preflight_test_design: Hand-curate at least 50 paraphrase queries whose ground-truth targets are known codebook variables. Verify that the intended variable is recovered in the top-k for at least 90% of queries. Fail the pipeline if quality is below this threshold.

dm_test_procedure.aggregation_reconciliation_diagnostic: Recompute the DM test under both pooled-per-firm-quarter losses and per-quarter-mean losses; identify which aggregation reproduces the paper's reported DM differentials; report both as sensitivity.

api_keys_and_access.secrets_management_rule: Load from environment or secret manager; never hard-code; never commit.

methodological_notes.note_1_shared_target: Every specialist is scored against the SAME look-ahead price target. Perspective disentanglement lives in the PROMPT PRIOR, not in the objective.
methodological_notes.note_2_two_lossy_channels: Cross-perspective information travels as scalar losses and prediction vectors; memory-to-policy information travels as natural-language prose. Both channels are lossy and non-invertible.
methodological_notes.note_3_price_level_target: The target is a PRICE LEVEL, not a return. No portfolio-level or risk-adjusted validation is performed in the paper; no economic claim is therefore established.
methodological_notes.note_4_interpretability_circularity: Because perspectives are prompt-imposed, correspondence between learned equations and canonical valuation forms is partly induced by the prior. The genuine finding is the DEFORMATION of canonical forms by data; the shuffled-prior control is the correct test.
methodological_notes.note_5_coefficient_non_interpretability: Raw-scale regressors yield dimensionally arbitrary fitted constants. Only STRUCTURE is interpretable; coefficients are not. Standardisation inside the DE fitter mitigates but does not eliminate this.
methodological_notes.note_6_oracle_infeasibility: The oracle single-agent ablation is not a deployable strategy; its catastrophic Russell 2000 degradation demonstrates that combination, not selection, is the correct primitive.
methodological_notes.note_7_context_conditioning_duplicated: Context enters via the coordinator AND via learned indicator switches inside the specialists. This redundancy is neither ablated nor discussed in the paper.
methodological_notes.note_8_regime_causality_unspecified: The paper never states whether regime labels are causal at t or ex-post. Peak/trough dating is normally confirmatory. Implement both; treat the causal variant as primary.
methodological_notes.note_9_release_without_locator: Artifacts are promised at four separate points but no repository locator is provided anywhere. All released artifacts must be transcribed from Appendices C, D, and E.
methodological_notes.note_10_stochasticity_unquantified: Single runs on a single four-billion-parameter backbone with no seed replicates leaves the headline point estimates without uncertainty quantification.
methodological_notes.note_11_compute_parity_unstated: No compute-parity statement is provided versus PySR, LLM-SR, or FunSearch, though MUFASA is strictly more elaborate.
methodological_notes.note_12_licensing_boundary: Fundamentals come from a licensed commercial vendor and macro from a second licensed vendor. A reproduction can replicate the methodology exactly but cannot verify that its data is bit-identical.

Fundamentals and macro are licensed; no redistributable extract.
synthesis.final_honesty_statement: This dictionary is the complete configuration surface as far as the paper permits. Every entry carries a provenance tag. Entries tagged [UNSPECIFIED IN MANUSCRIPT] are reproduction decisions and MUST be reported as such alongside any claim of replication. Entries tagged [ABSENT] record confirmed omissions and cannot be reconstructed except by decision. No reproduction claim should be made without resolving all four internal conflicts, passing all nine verification gates, and publishing the gap-decision register verbatim.
